summary.business_type: E-commerce — consumer tech/gadget store (WooCommerce, dropship/affiliate model)
top_findings: Product images are broken site-wide (malformed concatenated URLs 301 then 404) — products show no image and are disqualified from image/merchant rich results
360 of 671 product URLs (53%) are live, indexable, self-canonical '__trashed'-slug pages with full Product schema = massive index bloat and quality dilution

Blog is 147 off-topic, mass-generated drone-travel-photography posts on a gadget store; product copy is machine-spun ('JBL cost 4 moveable... energy financial institution') = severe E-E-A-T and topical-coherence failure
No page caching (TTFB ~400ms) + 27-30 render-blocking scripts + LCP gated behind a 1x1 GIF JS placeholder = Poor estimated LCP (4-6s mobile)
Five security headers missing (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy); sitemap index served over http://; homepage has no H1
quick_wins: Set WordPress Site/Home URL to https and flush Yoast sitemap cache (fixes http:// sitemap protocol mismatch)
Delete the default /sample-page/ and noindex cart/account/wishlist/compare utility pages
Add a single <h1> to the homepage via an Elementor Heading widget
Add the five missing security response headers in .htaccess / Hostinger header panel
Create /llms.txt declaring the store's identity and product categories
Collapse the two duplicate 'User-agent: *' blocks in robots.txt into one

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: http->https and www->non-www are clean single-hop 301s
Viewport meta correct, no user-scalable restriction

findings.title: 360 '__trashed' product pages indexed and self-canonicalized
findings.description: 360/671 product sitemap entries are live (HTTP 200), self-canonical, index,follow pages carrying full Product schema. Index bloat and quality dilution at scale.
findings.recommendation: Decide per URL: clean+301 the live products with ugly slugs; for genuinely discontinued items return 410 + noindex and remove from sitemap via Yoast filter.

findings.title: robots.txt has two conflicting 'User-agent: *' blocks; Sitemap line uses http://
findings.description: A WooCommerce block and a Yoast block both declare User-agent: *. The Yoast block's empty Disallow: shadows the WooCommerce ?add-to-cart= blocks. Sitemap directive uses http not https.
findings.recommendation: Merge into one User-agent: * block, keep the add-to-cart disallows, set Sitemap to https://.

findings.title: Sitemap index serves all child <loc> entries over http://
findings.description: sitemap_index.xml references 163+ child sitemaps via http://, forcing a 301 per fetch and wasting crawl budget; inconsistent with the https canonical site.
findings.recommendation: Set WP Site/Home URL to https, flush Yoast sitemap cache, verify with curl -sI.

findings.title: Five security headers absent
findings.description: No HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy on any response. Only CSP upgrade-insecure-requests present.
findings.recommendation: Add all five headers in .htaccess or Hostinger's header panel.

findings.title: Homepage has zero H1 elements
findings.description: No <h1> anywhere in the rendered homepage; Elementor/Rehub hero uses non-semantic containers.
findings.recommendation: Add one H1 Heading widget for the primary headline.

findings.title: Tag/attribute archive bloat & IndexNow absent
findings.description: 164 post tags and many pa_* product-attribute archives are indexable; IndexNow not implemented.
findings.recommendation: noindex thin tag/attribute archives; enable IndexNow for faster (re)indexing of fixes.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Amazon Associates affiliate disclosure exists (on a hidden About page)
Within-post lexical diversity is adequate (cleaned-text scorer 87/100); the problem is structural, not per-token

findings.title: 147 off-topic, mass-generated blog posts
findings.description: Almost the entire blog is drone travel photography on a general gadget store, with near-duplicate synonym titles ('Soaring High...', 'Wanderlust Above...'). Topical coherence 10/100, AI/mass-generation signal scored 5/100. Most posts show ~5 views in source.
findings.recommendation: Stop publishing off-topic drone content. Pivot to product-adjacent buying guides (audio gear, gaming peripherals, laptop comparisons) or noindex/prune the drone corpus.

findings.title: Product descriptions are machine-spun/scraped
findings.description: JBL Charge 4 copy reads 'the JBL cost 4 moveable Bluetooth speaker with a built-in energy financial institution to cost your units' — spun text no user or AI engine would trust or cite.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite product descriptions as original, specific copy with specs, use cases, and comparisons.

findings.title: E-E-A-T near-zero
findings.description: No author bylines/Person, no real About/Contact/team, no credentials or external mentions. The only About is an unlisted 219-word boilerplate page.
findings.recommendation: Add real About + Contact + policies, author bios, and visible affiliate disclosure on every page with affiliate links (FTC/Amazon TOS).

findings.title: Affiliate disclosure not shown where links appear
findings.description: Disclosure lives only on a hidden About page, not on product pages/posts that contain affiliate links.
findings.recommendation: Surface a visible disclosure on every monetized page.

findings.title: Homepage missing H1
findings.description: No H1 on the homepage (also logged under Technical).
findings.recommendation: Add a single descriptive H1.

findings.title: 360 ugly '__trashed' product slugs
findings.description: Live, buyable products with corrupted slugs hurt relevance, CTR and shareability.
findings.recommendation: Rename to clean keyword slugs and 301 the old URLs; de-duplicate.

findings.title: Incoherent internal-linking architecture
findings.description: Off-topic blog silo with no links into the catalog; empty homepage product modules pass little equity to PLPs/PDPs.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild internal links from content to relevant categories/products; fix homepage modules.

findings.title: Unlinked/missing trust pages + default sample-page
findings.description: About is unlisted boilerplate; no contact in nav; /sample-page/ still live and in sitemap.
findings.recommendation: Publish and link real About/Contact; delete sample-page; noindex utility pages.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid WebSite + SearchAction (sitelinks search box eligible)
Product/Offer present with sku, seller, priceValidUntil, availability
Blog posts carry Article + Person + Breadcrumb

findings.title: Product image field unusable (broken URL)
findings.description: Product schema 'image' points at the malformed 404 URL, disqualifying image rich results / merchant listings.
findings.recommendation: Re-host images locally and correct the schema image URL.

findings.title: Trashed-slug products still emit valid InStock Product schema
findings.description: Abandoned-looking '__trashed' URLs advertise InStock Offers to Google.
findings.recommendation: 410 + noindex truly discontinued products; clean up the rest.

findings.title: No merchant shippingDetails or hasMerchantReturnPolicy
findings.description: Both required for Google merchant listing eligibility; absent on all products.
findings.recommendation: Add OfferShippingDetails and MerchantReturnPolicy via Yoast WooCommerce SEO or a filter.

findings.title: No aggregateRating / review on any product
findings.description: WooCommerce reviews enabled but ratings not surfaced in schema; highest-impact missing rich result (SERP stars). Also missing brand, itemCondition, gtin/mpn.
findings.recommendation: Add AggregateRating/Review when reviews exist; add brand, itemCondition (NewCondition), and gtin/mpn.

findings.title: Root-level Offer.price / FAQPage opportunities
findings.description: Price is expressed via priceSpecification/UnitPriceSpecification; ensure a root-level Offer.price/priceCurrency too. No FAQPage anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Add root Offer.price; add FAQPage on key product/category pages.

findings.title: 27-30 render-blocking scripts on every page
findings.description: jQuery + 3 Elementor bundles + 15+ Rehub scripts + WooCommerce attribution load before first paint; only 13/43 deferred. Primary LCP killer.
findings.recommendation: Defer all non-jQuery scripts; use Elementor performance settings; remove unused Rehub modules.

findings.title: No edge/page caching — every request hits origin PHP
findings.description: cache-control public max-age=0 and x-hcdn-cache-status: DYNAMIC; TTFB 374-410ms cold-PHP floor.
findings.recommendation: Install LiteSpeed Cache (Hostinger-native, free); target TTFB <100ms.

findings.title: No LCP image preload; 104KB PNG logo
findings.description: No preload for any LCP candidate; LCP gated behind a 1x1 GIF JS placeholder; homepage banner image 404s.
findings.recommendation: Convert logo to WebP/SVG, preload the real LCP image with fetchpriority=high, remove the GIF gate.

findings.title: No font-display:swap; 107KB Roboto CSS
findings.description: Self-hosted @font-face blocks lack font-display:swap (FOIT), delaying text render.
findings.recommendation: Add font-display:swap; subset to used weights.

findings.title: Blog images: 36/43 not lazy-loaded; one AVIF repeated 8x
findings.description: Eager-loaded below-fold images; duplicate requests; one image missing dimensions (CLS).
findings.recommendation: Enable lazy-load, deduplicate, add width/height.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Organization + WebSite schema present as an entity base

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: No machine-readable identity declaration; given topical incoherence, AI crawlers cannot determine what the store sells.
findings.recommendation: Create /llms.txt with store identity, categories, and key URLs (highest-ROI GEO action).

findings.title: Off-topic blog poisons entity identity
findings.description: AI systems associate the brand with drone photography, not electronics retail.
findings.recommendation: Pivot blog to product-adjacent topics or noindex the drone corpus.

findings.title: Product content is uncitable
findings.description: Spun copy, no FAQ, no question headings, no 134-167 word answer passages, no comparison content. Citability 22/100.
findings.recommendation: Add original spec tables, FAQ blocks, 'who should buy', and 'X vs Y' comparisons.

findings.title: Near-zero brand/entity off-site signals
findings.description: sameAs contains a single (Australian Pinterest) URL; no YouTube/Facebook/Instagram/X/LinkedIn/Wikipedia; primaryImage is a blank GIF.
findings.recommendation: Build and link real social/brand profiles; populate sameAs; set a real org logo/image.

categories.name: Images
what_works: WebP/AVIF used for some theme/blog imagery
Homepage decorative images carry alt text

findings.title: Product images broken site-wide (404)
findings.description: Malformed URLs prepend WP uploads to a full Amazon URL; 301 then 404. Products show broken images; schema image unusable.
findings.recommendation: Re-import images locally (wp media import) and re-attach; correct stored URLs.

findings.title: Homepage primary/OG image is a blank 1x1 GIF
findings.description: Social/AI previews and ImageObject schema carry no real image.
findings.recommendation: Set a real 1200x630 OG image and a real primary image.

findings.title: 104KB PNG logo, no modern format/preload
findings.description: LCP candidate logo heavy and unoptimized.
findings.recommendation: Export optimized SVG/WebP; preload.

findings.title: Lazy-loading absent; duplicate image; missing dimensions
findings.description: 36/43 blog images eager-loaded; one AVIF referenced 8x; CLS from missing width/height.
findings.recommendation: Enable lazy-load, deduplicate, add intrinsic dimensions.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix product image URLs site-wide (re-import to local media; correct schema image)
Resolve the 360 '__trashed' product URLs: clean slug + 301 for live items, 410 + noindex + sitemap removal for discontinued
Set WP Site/Home URL to https and flush Yoast sitemap cache (fix http:// sitemap + protocol redirects)
Add the five missing security headers
Add a homepage H1; delete /sample-page/; collapse duplicate robots.txt UA blocks

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Install LiteSpeed Cache; defer non-jQuery scripts; add font-display:swap; preload LCP image; remove GIF LCP gate
Add merchant schema (shippingDetails, hasMerchantReturnPolicy), root Offer.price, brand, itemCondition, gtin/mpn, and AggregateRating where reviews exist
Rewrite top product descriptions as original copy; surface visible affiliate disclosure on monetized pages
Fix homepage product modules ('No products for this criteria'); add internal links from content to categories/products
Enable lazy-load, deduplicate images, add image dimensions; set real OG/primary images

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Decide blog strategy: prune/noindex off-topic drone corpus; build product-adjacent buying guides and X-vs-Y comparisons
Publish real About/Contact/policy pages with author bios (E-E-A-T); link from nav/footer
Create /llms.txt; build and link real social/brand profiles; populate sameAs
Add FAQ blocks and spec tables to top products/categories for citability
noindex thin tag/attribute archives; enable IndexNow

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Verify fixes in Google Search Console (indexation, rich results, CWV field data)
Capture an SEO drift baseline (/seo drift baseline) and re-audit monthly
Track product image 404 regressions; monitor crawl stats for index bloat
Run PageSpeed Insights to validate the lab CWV estimates with field data

artifacts.notes: No Google API / CrUX field data available (lab estimates only). No Moz/Bing backlink API; Common Crawl shows domain not yet in web-graph (too new/small). Playwright screenshots unavailable in this environment (browser CA trust).
